serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The QuestionPro Gov offering delivers innovation management and crowdsourcing capabilities in a secure environment, allowing Government agencies to create surveys and then collect, analyze, and store the data from those surveys. QuestionPro uses crowdsourcing to help organizations find and develop the next big thing, whether that be new policies and services or new cost-savings and employee engagement measures. QuestionPro allows organizations to solicit input from personnel and other stakeholders and collaboratively transform that input into actionable project plans.
